changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'CompanyDomainGroup') BEGIN create table [dbo].CompanyDomainGroup ( ID int identity NOT NULL, CompanyID int NOT NULL, DomainSettingID int NOT NULL, GroupName nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, IsAdministrator bit NOT NULL, constraint PK_CompanyDomainGroup primary key clustered ( [ID] asc ) ) END

changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_CompanyDomainGroup_CompanyDomainSetting') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_CompanyDomainGroup_CompanyDomainSetting on dbo.CompanyDomainGroup ( CompanyID, DomainSettingID ) END
